family: R24-L1 BUILDER: high-recall Layer-1 generator pool (v38+v33+majority union) + FIRST-EVER MAE metric
hypothesis: User pipeline L1 = many signals, possibly huge profit + high DD/MAE; L2 filters; L3 caps risk. Union of three frozen identity/majority books maximizes recall (no filtering). MAE (never measured in this program) is reported per stage starting here.
source_policy: VERIFY each exists, record actual counts; skip missing with note, do not invent. Count mismatch vs expected is recorded as deviation, not fatal.

union_rule.first_seen_priority: v38_identity > v33_identity > majority_1x (listed order; keep first-seen row geometry AND scores on conflict)
union_rule.geometry: no refit, no recompute; conflicts + geometry-diffs counted and recorded
union_rule.hygiene: drop redundant 'action' column (direction carries it); engine run drops 'leverage' (fixed 1x via ExecutionConfig); handoff pool file keeps full column union + source tags; sort pool by signal_time; reset index

mae_def.window: candles.iloc[entry_index:exit_index+1] on engine-sorted reset-index candles (data/processed/swing_regime_research_v4/candles.parquet), inclusive both ends
mae_def.LONG: MAE_frac = max(0, (entry - min_low)/entry); MFE_frac = max(0, (max_high - entry)/entry)
mae_def.SHORT: MAE_frac = max(0, (max_high - entry)/entry); MFE_frac = max(0, (entry - min_low)/entry)

rules: no live orders; local backtests only
NEVER touch research/parallel/registry.json, CONTINUOUS_RESEARCH.md, NEXT_AGENT.md, research/parallel/rounds/*, ../Kronos, C:/Users/trait/.codex/worktrees/*
no register/assign/rotate; no commit/push; no overwrites (output dir must not exist; config/script/output are new only)
causal past-only; set ops on frozen signals only, never refit
exploratory labels; opened 2023-2026 development interval, NOT independent test
pre-specify this config BEFORE running (driver asserts branches/sources/union-rule/MAE-def)
